src:
PUSH    CS
POP     ES
MOV     BX, OFFSET SECT1 ; ES:BX = a 512-byte buffer
MOV     AX, 0201h        ; AH = 02h read, AL = 1 sector
MOV     CX, 0001h        ; CH = cylinder 0, CL = sector 1 (sectors count from 1)
MOV     DX, 0080h        ; DH = head 0, DL = 80h, the first hard disk
INT     13h
JC      FAIL1            ; CF = 1: AH = what went wrong
MOV     DX, OFFSET OK1
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the $-string at DS:DX
INT     21h
MOV     AL, SECT1+1FEh   ; the boot signature: 55h AAh on a real disk
CALL    PHEX2
MOV     DL, " "
MOV     AH, 02h          ; DOS: print the character in DL
INT     21h
MOV     AL, SECT1+1FFh
CALL    PHEX2
JMP     DONE1
FAIL1:
MOV     BL, AH           ; keep the status
MOV     DX, OFFSET BAD1
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the $-string at DS:DX
INT     21h
MOV     AL, BL
CALL    PHEX2
DONE1:

OK1     DB      "read ok, bytes at 1FEh: $"
BAD1    DB      "read failed, AH = $"
SECT1   DB      512 DUP (0)
PHEX2   PROC    NEAR     ; print AL as two hex digits; keeps every register
PUSH    AX
PUSH    CX
PUSH    DX
MOV     DH, AL           ; keep the byte
MOV     CL, 4
SHR     AL, CL           ; the high nibble
CALL    HEXN1
MOV     AL, DH
AND     AL, 0Fh          ; the low nibble
CALL    HEXN1
POP     DX
POP     CX
POP     AX
RET
HEXN1:
ADD     AL, "0"
CMP     AL, "9"
JBE     HEXN2
ADD     AL, 7            ; past "9": "A".."F"
HEXN2:
MOV     DL, AL
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
RET
PHEX2   ENDP
